points.description: States that the Euler tour is a walk around the tree starting at the root (traversing/going around the tree), visiting each node three times: from the left, from below (in between), and from the right (or equivalent wording, e.g. preorder, inorder and postorder visits combined).
points.partial_credit: Award 2-3 marks for a related but incomplete statement, e.g. a walk/traversal around the tree from the root without the three visits per node, or mentioning that nodes are visited several times/left-below-right without the walk idea.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying the Euler tour is a walk around the tree from the root in which each node is encountered three times (left, below, right), in any wording. Part marks for a vague or half-right answer, such as just a walk around the tree or just visiting nodes multiple times. No marks for describing an unrelated traversal, such as plain BFS, with no walk-around or repeated-visit idea; extra correct detail is fine.
